(2) A split-screen comparison appears, showing dull, frizzy hair on the left and smooth, shiny hair on the right; the woman is seen from the back in a studio setting. (3) Close-up shots depict the woman touching and pulling at damaged hair strands, followed by a graphic of a dry, withered broom as a metaphor. (4) The woman returns to the red background, holding up three fingers and gesturing toward the camera. (5) In a bathroom setting with white tiles, the woman is seen washing her hair, applying a white creamy product from a large red bottle. (6) A series of fast-cut scenes show the woman at a formal event in a gold sequined dress, followed by a salon scene where a stylist uses a hair iron on her. (7) Close-ups of product bottles labeled 'VS' appear on white pedestals against a dark red silk background. (8) Detailed shots show the hair transition from wet to dry and silky, with fingers combing through the strands. (9) The video concludes with the woman posing with two product bottles and a final split-screen comparison for a voting prompt.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy female narrator speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo electronic pop track with a steady percussion beat. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition. (2) As the narrator describes hair texture problems, her voice remains energetic but takes on a slightly dramatic inflection. The BGM maintains its rhythm, while a short, high-pitched 'ding' signals a shift in the visual content. (3) During the product demonstration, the audio features the subtle mechanical sound of a pump being depressed, followed by the soft, wet sound of product application. The vocal tone becomes more instructional and reassuring. (4) The final phase features a triumphant and joyful vocal delivery as results are revealed, with the BGM swelling slightly in volume before a clean fade-out.
